name: Whimsical Dark
description: Childhood storybook surface with adult menace underneath. Ghibli-meets-Grimm.
voice_instruct: Narrate with warm, intimate cadence — like reading aloud to one specific child. Soften the consonants. Pause for the funny lines AND the disturbing ones; let the listener feel the gear-shift.
music_query: gentle music box piano with low cello undertone
script_prompt_addendum: Open warm and storybook-soft. Let the menace creep in by scene 3 through small wrong details (the mother's smile lasted a beat too long; the cat's shadow had four legs but the cat had three). Never break the fairy-tale register — keep the sentences short and lullaby-cadenced even when describing the worst moments.
